observations: Four gas burners with black individual pan supports.
Four silver-colored control knobs at the front.
Watermark 'ULTIMATE BATHROOM' visible across the center.
No brand name or model number is visible on the top surface.

risks.risk: Functional condition of ignition and gas valves
risks.proof: Video showing all four burners being ignited and the flame adjusted.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate, usually located on the underside.

risks.risk: Integrity of the glass surface (cracks or deep scratches)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surface under direct light.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label or rating plate on the underside of the unit.
Video showing the electronic ignition sparking and all burners lit.
Clear photo of any brand logo if printed on the glass surface.
response.reason: The brand and model are not visible. In the appliance market, the manufacturer significantly dictates the price, and the identification plate on the underside is required to establish value beyond a generic worst-case.
